Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.schema

Class DomainLineageResolver

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.schema.DomainLineageResolver
public final class DomainLineageResolver extends Object
Resolvedor canonico e deterministico de DomainLineage e DomainGovernance compartilhado entre OpenAPI (CustomOpenApiResolver), catalogo semantico (SemanticDomainCatalogService), revisor estatico (SemanticMetadataReviewer) e exportacao governada (ResourceExportSupport) (P44–P50, P60, P64).
